level: configuration-commit Windows file-stability component fix under W06.14; no activation or product wiring
componentAcceptance: Win11 / Node v24.20.0: the root cause is reproduced as delayed ctimeNs commits after real hardlink publication, with dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/nlink unchanged. Final behavior allows only Win32 read-stable ctime drift to trigger at most two 10ms-delayed complete rereads; every other field, phase and POSIX mismatch remains immediate fail-closed. Five deterministic tests pass, the final 5000-iteration real hardlink probe has zero unstable images, all 12 final parallel configuration-commit runs pass, the related combination is 96 tests / 89 pass / 0 fail / 7 skip, and root regression is 1905 tests / 1835 pass / 0 fail / 70 skip.
productAcceptance: None. This fixes a false-positive file-image stability observation in the private configuration transaction. It does not prove external writers stopped, change activationSupported / postActivationRollbackSupported / stopWriteProvable, complete W06.15, or advance product scores from 0/20, 1/63 and M0 11/12.
implementation: SOURCE_CHANGED errors now carry bounded diagnostic details without paths or file contents: open-identity, read-stable, read-length and published-image include the relevant observation, field, expected/actual metadata, digest and phase.

migrationImageMetadataMismatch strictly compares dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/nlink across lstat/open/read/fstat/lstat. POSIX ctime retains the original pre-open baseline; Windows uses the opened handle as the current read baseline.

image() retries only when migrationImageCtimeRetry proves Win32 + read-stable + field=ctimeNs. It performs at most two additional complete image reads 10ms apart, reopening and rereading the file and rechecking every field. Exhaustion rethrows the original SOURCE_CHANGED.
Digest, identity, size, mtime, nlink, open-identity, read-length, published-image and POSIX mismatches never qualify for retry. Concurrent content edits remain refusals, not accepted states.
testRuns: Diagnostic sampling before the fix: 8 serial plus 16 parallel configuration-commit runs (24 total) all passed. This non-reproduction was not used as a fix claim.

A real hardlink probe using write stage -> link -> unlink -> lstat/open/read/fstat/lstat failed at iteration 70: only ctimeNs changed from 1793426594235729200 to 1793426594236728300 between the first lstat and opened fstat; dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/nlink stayed identical.

The first opened-ctime-baseline implementation passed 12 parallel configuration-commit runs but the same 5000-iteration probe failed again at iteration 1588, now at after-read on ctimeNs. That implementation was explicitly judged insufficient and was not delivered as final.
Final deterministic helper suite: 5 tests, 5 pass, covering pre-open settle, after-read drift, nlink drift on both platforms, POSIX strictness and the closed retry predicate.
Final real hardlink probe using the same bounded complete-reread contract: 5000 iterations, zero unstable images.
Final configuration-commit stress: 12 parallel runs, all 12/12 pass. Logs: tmp/integration/migration-source-e81/final-*.log.
Final related combination: 96 tests, 89 pass, 0 fail, 7 skipped, exit 0. npm run check:client reports OK and the documentation four-suite run is 26/26.
Final npm test: 1905 tests, 1835 pass, 0 fail, 70 skipped, exit 0 (tmp/integration/migration-source-e81/root-final.log). The five new tests account for the increase from E80's 1900.
preservedFailures: E79's original SOURCE_CHANGED logs remain unchanged. The E81 investigation also preserves the 24-run non-reproduction, iteration-70 root reproduction and iteration-1588 failure of the first insufficient implementation.
Only the observed Windows ctime timing false positive is fixed. Other present or future SOURCE_CHANGED causes must still be diagnosed from their field and must not be silently retried.
W06.15 external isolation, real old entry points, Linux backend, activation and production migration remain open. No user profile or real model call was used.
limitations: The real probe and stress evidence is win32-only. POSIX strict behavior is covered deterministically but this session did not execute a Linux host.
Bounded reread is not a stop-write mechanism and does not replace the fence, writer inventory, OS isolation or capture verification.
Metadata diagnostics intentionally omit paths and file contents; public evidence records only synthetic values and fixed diagnostic categories.
